text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, cisatracurium besylate is listed by FDA as To Be Discontinued. No FDA shortage signal is posted for the Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. product labeled as manufactured by HIKMA FARMACÊUTICA (PORTUGAL). Current inventory: Corvale East holds 39 units at 3.5 units per day for 11 days on hand; Corvale General holds 126 units at 4.1 units per day for 31 days on hand; Corvale Lakeside holds 23 units at 0.8 units per day for 30 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the drug status is To Be Discontinued since an unspecified date. No shortage signal exists for the Hikma product.

Our position: Supply is adequate at Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside. Corvale East has limited days on hand. The best available option per rule is to buy from Armas Pharmaceuticals, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Armas Pharmaceuticals; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Avenacy, LLC as secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc. as tertiary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor Corvale East usage daily and report to Pharmacy Director.
5. Pharmacy Director to present supply status to P&T Committee at next meeting.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
